definitions.delta: candidate minus baseline; negative error delta=improvement
definitions.sse_log: sum of squared log errors (additive across partitions)
definitions.overall_msle_contribution: delta_sse_log / all 28512 rows; NOT an RMSLE contribution
definitions.under_over_sse: each model classified by its own residual sign; inspect transitions too
definitions.baseline_direction: fixed rows classified by baseline sign for paired comparison
definitions.sales_bias: sum(predicted sales - actual sales); not the competition metric

limitations: No surge/drop/volatility labels: these require pre-cutoff sales history.
Different candidate iteration counts; comparison is of complete configurations.
2017-selected settings evaluated retrospectively on 2016; descriptive diagnostic.
